title: QUALITY — Content freshness decay — auto-archive stale queue items older than 7 days
description: Prevent stale trending-topic queue items from being acted upon weeks after they were added. Script stamps pending items with created_at on first run. On subsequent runs, archives items older than 7 days to workspace/scs001/archived-queue.jsonl and marks them stale-archived in sprint-queue.json. PM2 cron daily at midnight.

tasks.title: Create scripts/scs001/archive-stale-queue.ts — content freshness decay archiver
tasks.description: Read workspace/sprint-queue.json. For each pending item without created_at: add created_at=today. For each pending item with created_at older than 7 days: mark status=stale-archived, append to workspace/scs001/archived-queue.jsonl. Write updated queue back. Log count. Max 100 lines. No external deps.

tasks.title: Add PM2 cron entry to ecosystem.config.js for daily archival at midnight
tasks.description: Add scs001-queue-archiver PM2 entry with cron_restart: '5 0 * * *' (12:05am daily). autorestart: false, watch: false.
